div.head: III Eg 1.2
div.ab: ⁊ sý on þære bote swylc forgifnes, swylce hit for Gode gebeorglic sy ⁊ for worulde aberendlic.
⁊ sy on þære bote swilc forgyfnes, swilce hit for Gode gebeorhlic sy ⁊ for worulde aberendlic.
Et sit in emendationibus remissio uenialis apud Deum et apud seculum tolerabilis.
⁊ sy on ðare bote swilc forgifnes, swilce hit for Gode gebeorhlic sy ⁊ for worlde aberendlic.
And sy on þære bote swylc forgifnes, swylce hit for Gode gebeorglic sy and for worulde aberendlic.
And that there be such remission in the case of compensations as shall be justifiable in the sight of God and acceptable in the eyes of men.
And that penalties are to be assessed with such leniency as would be fitting before God and acceptable in the eyes of the world.
And there is to be such remission in the compensation as is justifiable before God and supportable in the state.
Und bei der [zuzuerkennenden] Bussenstrafe herrsche soweit Verzeihung, wie es sich vor Gott verantworten und im Staate ertragen lässt.
And in the [penalty of] compensation [to be awarded] let there be such leniency as can be justified before God and tolerated in the world.
